description: Push a FULL inventory snapshot for an External (non-warehoused) warehouse. Set semantics: the list is the complete on-hand picture — items omitted from it are ZEROED. Empty snapshots, non-External warehouses, oversized lists (max 5000 items — a snapshot is full-replace so it can't be chunked), and negative/absurd quantities or costs are rejected. If the snapshot would zero a large number of currently-stocked items (a truncated push wiping the catalog), it is refused unless confirmZeroing is set. The response always reports wouldZero/zeroed counts. Set dryRun=true to PREVIEW the effect (matched/skipped/wouldZero) without writing anything — nothing is zeroed, no sync timestamp is stamped, and the mass-zeroing guard is not applied so you always see the full blast radius before committing.

confirmZeroing.description: Set true ONLY to confirm a deliberate large delisting when the snapshot would zero more currently-stocked items than the safety threshold. Leave false for normal pushes — a false positive means the snapshot is probably truncated.

dryRun.description: Preview only: resolve identifiers and compute wouldZero without changing any on-hand row or stamping the feed. The response has DryRun=true and Zeroed=0. Takes precedence over the governance parameters (preview/previewReceipt) — a dryRun call never issues or consumes a receipt.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

items.description: Complete on-hand list: identifier (SKU, transfer SKU, or purchase SKU — UPC is NOT matched here, unlike the sales-order tool) + quantity.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured matched/skipped/wouldZero preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.
